name: Noise
source:
Katze woke up in a room he can't identify. Besides, a man named Sieg watching him anxiously. 
"Where the hell is this? Who are you?"
....Katze lost his memory of the last few years since he fell from the cliff. 
The life with Sieg started...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026055.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
卡茨醒来时，发现自己身处一间陌生的房间。旁边，一个名叫齐格的男人正焦急地望着他。
「这里到底是哪儿？你又是谁？」
…卡茨从悬崖跌落后，失去了过去几年的记忆。
他与齐格共同生活的日子就此开始…

[据[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026055.html]DLsite英文版[/url]整理]
